$comment: Approved visual baseline. CI builds this commit, screenshots it with the current tests and fails on any difference. "initial" means this repository's first commit: the approved release snapshot. To approve an intentional visual change: review the diff images from the failing Validate run, then set approvedCommit to the commit that introduced the change (full hash) and add a history entry.
